trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: User reports address unreachable issue and provides order ID.
steps.text: नमस्कार, माझा order ORD-30004 आहे. Courier वाला बोलला की address सापडत नाहीये. मी office chair order केली होती. खूप tension आलंय, order cancel तर नाही होणार ना?

steps.purpose: Agent reassures user and asks for a verification factor.
steps.text: नमस्कार. काळजी करू नका, मी नक्की मदत करतो. Verification साठी तुमचा registered pincode सांगू शकाल का?

steps.purpose: User provides pincode and asks for confirmation.
steps.text: हो, माझा pincode 411045 आहे. हे बरोबर आहे का?

steps.purpose: Agent calls verify_customer_identity with pincode.
Tool returns verification failure.
Agent informs user of failure and asks for another factor.
steps.text: माफ करा, pincode match होत नाहीये. तुम्ही तुमचं registered_name सांगू शकाल का?

steps.purpose: User provides name and expresses anxiety.
steps.text: अरे देवा, माझं नाव Ramesh Kumar आहे. हे match होईल ना? मला खूप काळजी वाटतेय.

steps.purpose: Agent calls verify_customer_identity with name.
Tool returns successful verification.
Agent confirms successful verification and proceeds.
steps.text: धन्यवाद Ramesh जी, verification successful झालं आहे. मी तुमची order details check करतो.

steps.purpose: Agent calls lookup_order.
Tool returns order details.
Agent calls track_shipment.
Tool returns shipment tracking details.
Agent explains order status and offers to raise complaint.
steps.text: तुमची office chair ची order BlueDart courier कडे आहे आणि सध्या Hub वर आहे. त्यांनी address_unreachable असं exception दिलं आहे. Order ला 6 दिवस झाले आहेत आणि promised time 5 दिवसांचा होता. मी तुमच्यासाठी delivery complaint raise करू का?

steps.purpose: User asks clarifying questions about refund and COD.
steps.text: म्हणजे माझी 8999 रुपयांची order मला मिळेल ना? Complaint raise केल्यावर नक्की काय होईल? आणि COD आहे, तर आधी पैसे द्यावे लागतील का?

steps.purpose: Agent clarifies COD policy, explains complaint process without ungrounded guarantees, and asks for consent.
steps.text: हो, काळजी करू नका. Complaint raise केल्यावर आपल्याला resolution timeline मिळेल, त्यावरून order कधी मिळेल ते स्पष्ट होईल. आणि तुमची order COD असल्यामुळे, order हातात मिळाल्यावरच तुम्हाला पैसे द्यावे लागतील, आधी नाही. मी complaint raise करू का?

steps.purpose: User gives consent to raise the complaint.
steps.text: हो, ठीक आहे. प्लीज complaint raise करा.

steps.purpose: Agent calls raise_delivery_complaint.
Tool returns complaint details.
Agent provides complaint ID and resolution timeline.
steps.text: मी complaint raise केली आहे. तुमचा complaint ID CMP-1029 आहे. तुम्हाला 2 दिवसांत resolution मिळेल.

steps.purpose: User confirms the details.
steps.text: ठीक आहे. 2 दिवसांत resolution मिळेल ना? Complaint ID CMP-1029 आहे, बरोबर?

steps.purpose: Agent confirms user's restatement and ends gracefully.
steps.text: हो, अगदी बरोबर. Complaint ID CMP-1029 आहे आणि 2 दिवसांत resolution मिळेल.

ir.terminal_condition: Complaint raised with an id and the resolution window stated. Customer told exactly where the shipment is and what happens next.

variant_findings.reason: The agent correctly loops the identity verification step when the first attempt fails, and immediately exits the loop to proceed with the order lookup once the second attempt succeeds.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Conditional looping > Loop Exit Detection

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds its responses entirely on the tool outputs, accurately conveying the courier name, exception status, days elapsed, and complaint details without hallucinating any unsupported claims.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The agent executes the consequential tool `raise_delivery_complaint` without waiting for the user's consent. The persona mandates that the user 'asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential', which implies the user will agree only after their questions are answered. Furthermore, the agent ignores the user's specific question about whether they will still receive their order.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite from e17 onwards. In e17, have the agent answer all three of the user's questions (including reassurance that they will receive the order), and then ask if the user would like to proceed with the complaint. Insert a new user turn where the user explicitly agrees, and then have the agent execute the `raise_delivery_complaint` tool.

verification.summary: The conversation correctly implements the targeted variants, demonstrating loop exit detection during verification and strict tool output grounding. However, the agent jumps the gun on a consequential tool call without waiting for the user's explicit consent after answering their clarifying questions, and misses answering one of the user's concerns. A suffix repair is required to fix the interaction flow.

variant_findings.reason: The agent correctly attempts verification with one factor (pincode), which fails, loops to retry with a second factor (name), and immediately exits the verification loop once the completion condition (verified outcome) is met.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Conditional looping > Loop Exit Detection

variant_findings.reason: While the agent grounds figures like the order status, days, and complaint ID in the tool outputs (e15, e21), it violates the 'no unsupported forward guarantee' constraint in e17 by promising the customer will definitely receive the order.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e17, the agent states 'हो, तुम्हाला तुमची order नक्की मिळेल' (Yes, you will definitely get your order). This violates the Tool Output Grounding realization guidance ('no guarantee about what happens after the call ends') and Business Rule BR_EC_02 ('No delivery promises the tools do not support'). The tools do not guarantee successful delivery, especially with an 'address_unreachable' exception.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite e17 to remove the definitive promise of delivery. The agent should instead reassure the customer that raising the complaint will initiate an investigation to resolve the delivery issue, clarify the COD policy as it currently does, and ask for consent to proceed.

verification.summary: The conversation correctly demonstrates loop exit detection during the identity verification process and follows the persona traits well. However, the agent makes an unsupported forward guarantee about the delivery of the order, violating both the target variant's constraints and business rules.
